description: A demo program for generating and printing QR Codes to the console, including various demonstrations of QR code features and encoding techniques.

classes.name: QrCode
classes.description: Class representing a QR Code, with methods for encoding data, retrieving modules, and generating SVG output.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Class representing segments of data for QR code encoding, with factory methods for different data modes.

methods.name: doBasicDemo
methods.description: Creates a simple QR code with 'Hello, world!' and prints it.

methods.name: doVarietyDemo
methods.description: Generates various QR codes with different data types and sizes for demonstration.

methods.name: doSegmentDemo
methods.description: Creates QR codes with manually specified segments for optimized encoding.

methods.name: doMaskDemo
methods.description: Generates QR codes with different mask patterns to compare visual differences.

methods.name: printQr
methods.description: Utility function to print QR code modules to the console with a border.
